Looking at the qlang documentation and the tasks, I'll work through each query carefully, understanding the pipeline structure, filtering, grouping, and data transformations.

Let me trace through the key concepts:
- `|` chains steps
- `*` combinator applies code to each element
- `filter ~(...)` with quote predicates
- Soft reads with `at` return `null` if missing
- `groupBy ~(...)` groups by a key
- Named values with `:name value` are available in subsequent steps

Here are my queries:

T1: /data/users | filter ~(if (/active) ~(if (/email | ne null) ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") ~(false)) ~(false)) | count

T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | * /name | sort ~(lower)

T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | * count

T4: /data/users | filter ~(at :profile | at :age | ne null) | * (at :profile | at :age) | avg | round 2

T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * /name | * lower | distinct | sort

T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (/assignee | at :login)}

T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee | /login) | * count

T8: /dependencies | union /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * (:v /1 | /0 | keyword | append "@" | append v) | sort

T9: /services | filter ~(if (at :enabled | coalesce false) ~(if (/port | gt 8000) ~(true) ~(false)) ~(false)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","

T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(.) | * count

T11: lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") | * (split "ms=" | /1 | trim | parseJson) | avg | round 1

T12: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(if (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") ~(if (/4 | ne "") ~(true) ~(false)) ~(false)) | * (:qty (/3 | parseJson) | /4 | parseJson | mul qty) | sum | round 2

T13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(if (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") ~(if (/4 | ne "") ~(true) ~(false)) ~(false)) | * {:customer /1 :total (:qty (/3 | parseJson) | /4 | parseJson | mul qty)} | groupBy ~(/customer) | * sum | entries | sort ~(/1 | desc) | take 2 | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)}

T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
